capabilities: Copy text files to the clipboard as text
Copy images to the clipboard as PNG data
Copy other files to the clipboard as raw files
Configure copy behavior per file type
extras: Desktop only, and raw file copying uses PowerShell so it currently works only on Windows.
intentEvidence: Adds a Copy to clipboard option to the right-click menu of every file in the file explorer.
problem: Obsidian offers no way to copy a file itself (or its contents) to the system clipboard from the file explorer.
summary: File explorer context-menu plugin that copies any vault file to the clipboard as text, PNG image data, or a raw file.
